name: Annual leave (特別休假)
authority: 勞動基準法第38條 — 3 days after six months' continuous service, 7 after one year, 10 after two, 14 after three, 15 after five and one further day for every year beyond ten, capped at 30; the worker schedules the days and any unused day is paid out at the year end or on termination.

name: Ordinary injury or sickness leave (普通傷病假)
authority: 勞工請假規則第4條 — not more than 30 days a year where the worker is not hospitalised, at half wages; hospitalised leave is capped at one year within two years and 未住院傷病假 plus 住院傷病假 together at one year within two years.

name: Personal leave (事假)
authority: 勞工請假規則第7條 — not more than 14 days a year, unpaid; from 2026-01-01 it may be taken by the hour where it is used to care for a family member.

name: Marriage leave (婚假)
authority: 勞工請假規則第2條 — 8 days on full wages.

name: Bereavement leave (喪假)
authority: 勞工請假規則第3條 — 8 days on the death of a parent, adoptive or foster parent, or spouse; 6 days for a grandparent, child, or the spouse's parent or adoptive/foster parent; 3 days for a great-grandparent, sibling, or the spouse's grandparent. All are on full wages.

name: Occupational injury leave (公傷病假)
authority: 勞工請假規則第6條 with 勞動基準法第59條 — leave for the whole period of medical treatment and recuperation for an occupational injury or disease, with no day cap, at the 原領工資數額.

name: Maternity leave (產假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第15條第1項 with 勞動基準法第50條 — 8 weeks before and after childbirth; 4 weeks for a miscarriage at three months or more, 1 week at two months to under three, 5 days under two months. Wages are paid in full where service is six months or more and at half where it is less.

name: Paternity and accompanying-check-up leave (陪產檢及陪產假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第15條第5項 — 7 days on full wages, raised from 5 days on 2022-01-18; the employer may reclaim the sixth and seventh day from the Bureau of Labor Insurance.

name: Prenatal check-up leave (產檢假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第15條第4項 — 7 days on full wages.

name: Menstrual leave (生理假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第14條 — one day a month; up to three days a year are not counted against the 30-day ordinary sickness quota and days beyond three are counted into it. Every day is at half wages.

name: Family care leave (家庭照顧假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第20條 — 7 days a year, counted into the 14-day 事假 quota and therefore unpaid; from 2026-01-01 it may be taken by the hour (7 days = 56 hours).

name: Parental leave without pay (育嬰留職停薪)
authority: 性別平等工作法第16條 — after six months' service, unpaid leave until the child reaches three years of age, for at most two years per child; the 就業保險 parental allowance is 60% of the insured salary, topped up to 80%. From 2026-01-01 it may be claimed by the day for periods under 30 days, 30 days per parent and 60 per couple.

name: Breastfeeding and milk-expressing time (哺乳及集乳時間)
authority: 性別平等工作法第18條 — 60 minutes a day for a child under two, with a further 30 minutes where extended work exceeds one hour; the time counts as paid working time.
